name: Blade Runners

tenures.source: the federation's own singles and tag ledgers, reposted whole to the newsgroup (promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-singles-record-1993-01-08.html, promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-tag-rankings-history-1993-01-07.html)

caption: Ranked fourth among the FWF's tag teams, and the team that lost one partner mid-match to a timekeeper's bell and replaced him with another.
notes: The team's first incarnation paired Rockwell with the wrestler the federation's own tag ledger later bills as "Scorpion" Stan Golding; it is listed as the "New Blade Runners" from the match Flann joined onward, under the same name in the same rankings.

identity.note: A separate entity from blade, blade-iwf, blade-xudf, and not a merge. The registry's own decorated-aka guard reads this name as a normalized substring match against theirs; what actually matches is one word of a moniker, across federations and eras with nothing else in common. Filed distinct under the collision doctrine's four-signal test — acronym, full name, dates and address — of which the label alone matches. In doubt, a new row.

caption: The federation's own tag tournament last-place finisher, sidelined for good after Storm hospitalized Boris with a concussion.
notes: Referred to in the tag ledger by team name only; Boris and Brutus are both named individually across the ledger and (Brutus) the Blade Runners' own recap.

name: Demolishers

tenures.source: the federation's own tag ledger, reposted whole on 7 January 1993 (promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-tag-rankings-history-1993-01-07.html), match 1

caption: Stopped their own federation debut against Storm when Storm broke Demolisher Venom's back — the earliest tag match the federation's own record shows.
notes: Pre-corpus: no held show text survives; attested only by the tag ledger's own line.

name: Devastation

tenures.source: the federation's own singles and tag ledgers, reposted whole to the newsgroup (promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-singles-record-1993-01-08.html, promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-tag-rankings-history-1993-01-07.html)

caption: Took the FWF Tag Team Championship off Storm with a flying headbutt, turned back the Chameleons, and lost the unified FWF/PWA titles at the Clash of the Masters on a fall the referee called with a foot on the rope.

identity.note: A separate entity from devastation-napw (NAPW), and not a merge — a shared label, thirteen years and two unconnected records apart. In doubt, a new row.

name: Sheepwhackers

caption: Lost to Doctor Death in a handicap match, then to the Raiders in their own tag division debut, then to the debuting Chameleons — who wrestled them in an exact copy of their own ring gear.

name: Storm

tenures.source: the federation's own singles and tag ledgers, reposted whole to the newsgroup (promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-singles-record-1993-01-08.html, promotions/fwf-1992/archive/fwf-tag-rankings-history-1993-01-07.html)

caption: Won the FWF Tag Team Championship tournament final and held the belts until Devastation took them, leaving a broken back, a broken arm and a concussion across the four teams it beat on the way.

identity.note: A separate entity from storm-napw (NAPW) and storm-nfw (NFW), and not a merge. The shared label is the only signal the collision doctrine's four-signal test finds: the promotions, the decades and the record all differ, and nothing connects them. In doubt, a new row.
